entries.summary: At Bolzano, Bertold of Taranto, acting in an imperial capacity, fixes a hearing date in a legal dispute concerning the parties from Nago and their representatives. Friedrich von Rosenberg appears among the witnesses.
entries.latin: Anno Domini millesimo CC XXXVIII, indictione undecima, die martis VII intrante septemb(re), in Bozano, aput albarumb) ad ecclesiam plebis Sancte Marie, in presentia dominic) Husid) canonici de Tridento, domini G(otschalci) de Grias, magistri Bononi medici, domini Co(nradi)e) de Winekof), domini Fr(iderici)g) de h) Rosenbach o , domini Ulricii) vicarii de Tirol, domini Albertini et Bertoletij) fratrum, Ulricik) Loaselinil), Bertoldi notarii, Wilielmim) specialis, Fr(iderici)g) de Nacu, Bonincontrin) et aliorum testium. Ibique dominus Bertoldus Tarantus de Tirol, delegatus domini imperatoris, statuit terminum Comiti de Naccu, presenti ex una parte, et Oberto notario, procuratori domini Martini burseriio) et Iohannis de Wadrilio ex altera, cum voluntate utriusque parcium, hinc ad proximum diem lune et deinde ad XV dies ut sint illa die Bozano coram eo in predicto loco et quod quilibet ibi habeat suum sapientem ad procedendum in causa. Ego Tridentinus, sacri palacii notarius, de licencia et auctoritate venerabilis patris domini H(enrici)p), Dei ac sedis apostolice gratia episcopi Tridentini, hunc suprascriptum instrumentum ex breviaturis condam Iacobi notarii de Bozano traxi et 1154-1284_II-Maior 1211 19-06-2007, 21:23 in publicam formam reduxi fideliter et legaliter, nichil addens vel diminuens quos sensum vel sentenciam mutet, meum signum apposuiq) et me subscripsi.
entries.english:
In the year of the Lord 1238, indiction eleven, on Tuesday, the seventh day of September, at Bolzano, at the Albarum by the parish church of Saint Mary, in the presence of Lord Husi, canon of Trento; Lord Gotschalc de Grias; Master Bono the physician; Lord Conrad de Weineck; Lord Friedrich von Rosenberg; Lord Ulricus, vicar of Tyrol; Lords Albertinus and Bertoletus, brothers; Ulricus Loaselini; Bertoldus the notary; Wilielmus Specialis; Frederick de Nacu; Bonincontrus and other witnesses.

There Lord Bertoldus Tarantus de Tyrol, acting as the emperor’s delegate, set a hearing date, with the consent of both parties, for the Count de Nago, present on one side, and on the other Obertus the notary, representative of Lord Martin the burserius and John de Wadrilio. He ordered them to appear before him at the aforesaid place in Bolzano on the next Monday and then after fifteen days, so that each might bring his own legal adviser to proceed in the case.

I, Tridentinus, notary of the Sacred Palace, by leave and authority of the venerable father Lord Henry, by the grace of God and of the Apostolic See bishop of Trento, faithfully and lawfully drew this aforesaid instrument from the abbreviated notes of the late Jacobus, notary of Bolzano, and reduced it to public form, adding or removing nothing that would change its meaning or sense; I placed my sign and subscribed.

facts.subject: Friedrich de Rosenbach
facts.content: appears among the witnesses to the proceeding.
